sentences.pt: No escritório, todo mundo sabia que Marcos nunca era pontual.
sentences.en: At the office, everyone knew that Marcos was never on time.

sentences.pt: Ele chegava sempre dez ou quinze minutos atrasado e tinha uma desculpa diferente para cada dia.
sentences.en: He always arrived ten or fifteen minutes late and had a different excuse for each day.

sentences.pt: Numa sexta-feira, a chefe, Patrícia, agendou uma reunião muito importante com um cliente de Lisboa.
sentences.en: One Friday, the boss, Patrícia, scheduled a very important meeting with a client from Lisbon.

sentences.pt: A reunião seria na segunda-feira, às oito da manhã em ponto.
sentences.en: The meeting would be on Monday, at eight in the morning sharp.

sentences.pt: "Espero que você chegue na hora desta vez", disse ela, brava.
sentences.en: "I hope you arrive on time this time," she said, annoyed.

sentences.pt: No domingo à noite, Marcos colocou o despertador do celular para tocar às seis e foi dormir cedo.
sentences.en: On Sunday night, Marcos set the alarm on his phone to ring at six and went to bed early.

sentences.pt: De madrugada, no entanto, caiu uma tempestade forte, com muitos raios e trovões.
sentences.en: In the early hours, however, a strong storm hit, with lots of lightning and thunder.

sentences.pt: Faltou energia no bairro inteiro, e o celular, que não estava carregado, apagou.
sentences.en: The power went out in the whole neighborhood, and the phone, which wasn't charged, died.

sentences.pt: Quando Marcos abriu os olhos, o sol já estava alto.
sentences.en: When Marcos opened his eyes, the sun was already high.

sentences.pt: Ele olhou o relógio da cozinha e viu que eram sete e quarenta.
sentences.en: He looked at the kitchen clock and saw that it was seven forty.

sentences.pt: Tomou um banho rápido, pôs a primeira roupa que encontrou e saiu correndo sem tomar café.
sentences.en: He took a quick shower, put on the first clothes he found and ran out without having breakfast.

sentences.pt: Chegou ao escritório às oito e vinte, cansado e com calor.
sentences.en: He arrived at the office at eight twenty, tired and hot.

sentences.pt: Para a surpresa dele, a sala de reuniões estava vazia.
sentences.en: To his surprise, the meeting room was empty.

sentences.pt: A secretária explicou que o voo do cliente tinha atrasado e que a reunião tinha sido adiada para terça-feira.
sentences.en: The secretary explained that the client's flight had been delayed and that the meeting had been postponed to Tuesday.

sentences.pt: Patrícia tinha mandado uma mensagem no domingo à noite, mas o celular dele estava sem energia.
sentences.en: Patrícia had sent a message on Sunday night, but his phone had no power.

sentences.pt: Marcos ficou aliviado, mas também um pouco envergonhado.
sentences.en: Marcos was relieved, but also a little embarrassed.

sentences.pt: Na terça-feira, ele chegou ao escritório às sete e meia, meia hora adiantado.
sentences.en: On Tuesday, he arrived at the office at seven thirty, half an hour early.

sentences.pt: Quando Patrícia entrou e o viu ali, ficou tão surpresa que quase deixou o café cair.
sentences.en: When Patrícia came in and saw him there, she was so surprised she almost dropped her coffee.

sentences.pt: A reunião foi um sucesso, e o cliente fechou um contrato de dois anos com a empresa.
sentences.en: The meeting was a success, and the client signed a two-year contract with the company.

sentences.pt: Desde então, Marcos usa o relógio antigo do avô, que não depende de energia nem de internet.
sentences.en: Since then, Marcos has used his grandfather's old watch, which doesn't depend on power or the internet.

sentences.pt: Ele ainda chega atrasado de vez em quando, mas raramente mais de cinco minutos.
sentences.en: He still arrives late from time to time, but rarely more than five minutes.

questions.q: A que horas era a reunião?
Por que Marcos não acordou na hora?
questions.qEn: Why didn't Marcos wake up on time?

questions.q: Por que a reunião foi adiada?

sentences.pt: Fernanda e Eduardo são casados há dez anos, mas até o ano passado nunca tinham viajado para a Europa.
sentences.en: Fernanda and Eduardo have been married for ten years, but until last year they had never traveled to Europe.

sentences.pt: No começo do ano, decidiram que, a longo prazo, aquela seria a viagem mais importante da década.
sentences.en: At the start of the year, they decided that, in the long run, that would be the most important trip of the decade.

sentences.pt: Durante o primeiro semestre, economizaram um pouco do salário todo mês.
sentences.en: During the first half of the year, they saved a bit of their salary every month.

sentences.pt: Em fevereiro, compraram as passagens para Lisboa para a primeira quinzena de julho.
sentences.en: In February, they bought the tickets to Lisbon for the first two weeks of July.

sentences.pt: Fernanda fez um roteiro com museus, praias e restaurantes típicos.
sentences.en: Fernanda made an itinerary with museums, beaches and typical restaurants.

sentences.pt: Em abril, porém, o chefe de Eduardo deu uma notícia ruim.
sentences.en: In April, however, Eduardo's boss gave some bad news.

sentences.pt: A empresa tinha recebido um projeto enorme, que precisava ser entregue até o fim do terceiro trimestre.
sentences.en: The company had received a huge project, which had to be delivered by the end of the third quarter.

sentences.pt: Por isso, ninguém da equipe poderia tirar férias em julho.
sentences.en: Because of that, no one on the team could take vacation in July.

sentences.pt: Eduardo chegou em casa triste e contou tudo para a esposa.
sentences.en: Eduardo came home sad and told his wife everything.

sentences.pt: Fernanda ficou frustrada, já que tinha esperado aquela viagem durante meses.
sentences.en: Fernanda was frustrated, since she had waited for that trip for months.

sentences.pt: "E se a gente adiasse a viagem para setembro?", perguntou Eduardo.
sentences.en: "What if we postponed the trip to September?" asked Eduardo.

sentences.pt: Ela achou que mudar as passagens seria muito caro.
sentences.en: She thought that changing the tickets would be very expensive.

sentences.pt: No outro dia, os dois abriram o aplicativo da empresa e pediram informações.
sentences.en: The next day, the two of them opened the airline's app and asked for information.

sentences.pt: Para a surpresa deles, a multa era pequena: apenas trezentos reais por pessoa.
sentences.en: To their surprise, the fee was small: only three hundred reais per person.

sentences.pt: Além disso, em setembro os hotéis seriam mais baratos e as praias estariam menos cheias.
sentences.en: Besides that, in September the hotels would be cheaper and the beaches would be less crowded.

sentences.pt: O clima também seria bom, nem muito quente nem muito frio.
sentences.en: The weather would also be good, neither too hot nor too cold.

sentences.pt: Então eles mudaram a data e alugaram um apartamento pequeno perto do rio.
sentences.en: So they changed the date and rented a small apartment near the river.

sentences.pt: Eduardo trabalhou muito durante o inverno, inclusive em alguns fins de semana.
sentences.en: Eduardo worked a lot during the winter, including on some weekends.

sentences.pt: O projeto foi entregue dois dias antes do prazo.
sentences.en: The project was delivered two days before the deadline.

sentences.pt: Em setembro, enfim, os dois embarcaram para Lisboa.
sentences.en: In September, at last, the two of them boarded for Lisbon.

sentences.pt: Na primeira noite, eles jantaram num restaurante típico, com vinho e peixe assado.
sentences.en: On the first night, they had dinner at a typical restaurant, with wine and roast fish.

sentences.pt: Fernanda disse que estava feliz por ter esperado.
sentences.en: Fernanda said that she was happy to have waited.

questions.q: Para quando eram as primeiras passagens?
questions.qEn: When were the first tickets for?

questions.q: Por que Eduardo não podia viajar em julho?
questions.qEn: Why couldn't Eduardo travel in July?
How much did it cost to change the tickets?
